minutes.headline: Select Board appointed Ruth Anderson to the Board of Registrars and approved a transfer of the Yatean Central Convenience liquor license.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with public comment and board remarks condemning personal attacks on volunteers at Town Meeting, with some disagreement among members over when to intervene. The board interviewed three Republican nominees and appointed one to the Board of Registrars, held a license hearing, and ratified beach staff. It reviewed the Town Manager's and its own FY2021 goals, vacancies, and the Town Manager's report. Members discussed returning to in-person meetings and chose to stay on Zoom for now.

public_comment.topic: Objected to personal attacks on public volunteers and business owners at Town Meeting and the lack of response to his point of order.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-0 by roll call to appoint Ruth Anderson to the Board of Registrars from the Republican Town Committee list, after interviewing three nominees.
The board approved by roll call the transfer of the common victualler license at 451 Mass Ave to Yatean Central Convenience Luneburg LLC.
The board ratified, by roll call, the Town Manager's appointments of the beach director and seasonal lifeguards.
The May 18 meeting will stay on Zoom while the chair and town manager work with PAC on the technical needs for hybrid meetings.
The Town Manager's composite evaluation was put off to next week, and the primary school fire alarm upgrade came in well below the original estimate.

why_it_matters: Residents who want to attend Select Board meetings in person cannot yet, and whether meetings are streamed live on YouTube is still being worked out with PAC.
The fire alarm upgrade is planned to be paid for this fiscal year from an earmark plus an anticipated school surplus, so it touches how school money is carried over and used.
watch_next: The Town Manager's composite evaluation, to be reviewed and discussed at next week's meeting.
The May 18 meeting, where the chair and town manager are to update the board on hybrid meeting requirements.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the Ruth Anderson appointment, the license approval, the fire alarm figures, the warrants and the evaluation deferral; the differences are mostly misheard names. The thing to check is the lifeguard ratification vote, which only our minutes record, and the May meeting format, which ours calls a decision to stay on Zoom while the official minutes leave it open.
